reason: The batch report behind the QR code and the money-back guarantee with nothing to ship back make a $24.99 first box an easy risk on a TikTok night. Pre-counted evening capsules might also get me to actually finish a box, unlike the half-used bottles in my drawer.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I'll probably end up with another half-used supplement in the drawer.
would_change_my_mind: If the foil sachets were clearly recyclable or the box were refillable, I'd be more comfortable; a higher launch price would push me to skip it.
